{{Quote|That which can heal can also break.|Kol Skywalker's ghost to his son, Cade|<ref name="Legacy 18" />}}
The '''skirmish at the Temple of the Sith''' began when [[Darth Krayt]] ordered [[Cade Skywalker]] to execute [[Hosk Trey'lis]], a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who had been captured by Skywalker some time previously. Cade refused, and thus Krayt executed Trey'lis himself. This provoked the errant Jedi's anger, but his father then appeared before him as a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]]. He advised Cade to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]; Cade used his power to break into the case that held his father's lightsaber. He then used the weapon to stab [[Darth Talon]] in the stomach, immediately taking her out of the fight.<ref name="Legacy 18" /> He then was attacked by [[Darth Nihl]]. Krayt stayed back and tried to persuade Cade to kill Nihl in anger and become a Sith. Eventually, Cade cut Nihl's arm off, threw him against a wall, and used [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] on him. Krayt then told Cade to avenge his father's death by killing Nihl.<ref name="Legacy 19" />

Cade refused, stating that it was what the Dark Lord wanted him to do, and then engaged Krayt. During their duel, Cade said he saw through the Force just how sick Krayt really was and questioned whether the rest of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] would be willing to follow him if they knew his true condition. He taunted Krayt, saying that even if he died, he would die as himself. If Krayt killed him, then he'd condemn himself to death as a mindless [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Vongspawn|growth]]. Meanwhile, the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']] was attacked by [[1st Imperial Center Core Defense Squadron|Skull Squadron]]; however, [[Morlish Veed]] ordered [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rulf Yage]] to call off the attack, citing that the Sith ordered the Temple's aerial space to be left undisturbed.<ref name="Legacy 19" />

Just as the duel between Skywalker and Emperor Krayt was reaching its climax, [[Morrigan Corde]] blasted open the window behind them, showering Krayt with [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] shards. Cade then jumped out and was rescued by [[Jariah Syn]] aboard the ''Mynock'', who pulled him inside. The ''Mynock'' then escaped the planet and jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]], but not before Corde revealed herself to Cade over a comlink. Corde revealed herself to be his mother, but when Cade demanded some answers, she replied that he wouldn't be getting any.<ref name="Legacy 19" />

Krayt ordered his Sith minions to find Cade again. He said that when he recaptured him, he would use his powers to heal himself and then kill him.<ref name="Legacy 19" />

Krayt was also furious at Nihl. He refused [[Darth Maladi]]'s offer to reattach Nihl's arm, and prepared to kill him. Wyyrlok informed him that Nihl may still serve. Krayt stripped Nihl of his position as a Hand, to Nihl's dismay, and replaced him with [[Darth Stryfe]]. He then sent Talon and Nihl to be healed, and assigned Maladi to use Yuuzhan Vong bio-technology to grow Nihl a new arm.
